title: Police Blotter: 8 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Eight people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 19–20, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges — DWI, family-violence assault, theft, drug possession and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Eight people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Thursday and Friday, November 19–20, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Vicente Nino Flores

Flores was arrested on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 11:40 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15 or higher, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jesus Alejandro Diaz Jr.

Diaz was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 2:51 a.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15 or higher, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Ruben Alonzo Vasquez III

Vasquez was arrested on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 3:14 a.m. on charges of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor, and criminal mischief involving property valued at $750 or more but less than $2,500, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

America Mia Zamora

Zamora was arrested on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 9:50 a.m. on charges of possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 3, less than 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor; driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor; and possession of marijuana, less than two ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on any of the charges at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Alejandro Ramon Ventura

Ventura was arrested by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 3:36 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Jaime Alejandro Garcia

Garcia was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 5:03 p.m. on a charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Itzel Analy Alvarez

Alvarez was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 5:32 p.m. on a charge of theft of property valued at $100 or more but less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Adrian Torres-Mata

Torres-Mata was arrested on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 9:45 p.m. on charges of resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor, and theft of mail involving 10 or fewer addresses, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
